text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired for service `inference-runtime-prod` (INC-2026-0479). Trigger: 5xx error rate spike from api-gateway (threshold breach >4%), rolling window 1m. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2026-0479

pagerduty: Auto-escalation to primary on-call (maria) — page sent at 2026-02-18T03:46:29Z.

maria: Acking and taking ownership. On it now. Investigating 5xx spike. ETA 10m.

jordan: @maria I can help with infra (autoscaler + pool). ping me when you want me to run scale-up.

sri: Noted increase in downstream error traces from router -> runtime. I'm pulling logs + traces.

maria: Quick checks:
- k8s pods for runtime show some OOM restarts on model-worker-3
- error pattern: `model_runner::kv_cache_timeout` + 503 to client
- health endpoint returns 200 for scaler, but 503 for model-worker pods

maria: Running basic health checks:
```
# curl health
curl -sS -D- https://inference.internal/health | head
kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide | egrep "model-worker"
```

maria: Results: 3/8 workers in CrashLoopBackOff, CPU spiking, memory high. Looks like bad batch/traffic causing OOM.

pagerduty: Incident status: acknowledged by maria. Escalation to secondary (jordan) in 5m if no progress.

jordan: Preparing to add capacity. Recommend temporary scale to 12 replicas and bump GPU pool for burst. Will coordinate with autoscaler team.

liam: From app logs I'm seeing increased `latency>1.5s` and `retry` floods from client side. Customers might be hitting retries. Sending list of top affected customers to thread in 2m.

maria: Mitigation plan (short):
1) Enable routing fallback to model-variant `inference-quantized-v2` for non-high-priority routes to reduce memory.
2) Temporarily scale model-worker replicas to 12.
3) Evict the noisy pods and restart the pool.
4) Watch error rate / 5xx and latency.

maria: Executing step 1 now — adding fallback route via router config.
```
# patch route
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: router-fallback
data:
  route: "fallback: inference-quantized-v2"
EOF
```

maria: Step 1 applied. Pushing config and restarting router pods (1/3) to pick up new routing.

eva: FYI monitoring: error rate dropped from 7.2% -> 4.8% after fallback applied (approx 60s). Still above threshold but improving.

maria: Now scaling model-worker deployment.
```
kubectl scale deploy model-worker -n runtime --replicas=12
```

jordan: Pushing GPU pool burst request (asking infra to add 2x nvidia-a10 nodes). Tagging infra on-call.

oncall-rotation-bot: Infra on-call (ops-team) paged: @sre-oncall.

sri: Collecting traces for the error window and creating a short eval rerun to reproduce. Also dumping KV-cache metrics.

maria: After scaling, observed fewer OOMs, crashloops down to 0/8. 5xx rate at 1.9% now. Latency trending back to baseline.

pagerduty: PD update: incident escalated? No — resolved enough for stabilization, incident remains acknowledged and is transitioning to mitigation.

liam: Customer impact assessment (prelim):~
- Affected surface: Hosted API (generation endpoints)
- Observed symptom: 503 errors and increased latency for ~8% of requests during peak (window 03:44-03:52 UTC).
- Severity: P1 -> P2 candidate if stable for 15m.
- Likely customer-visible impact: several high-volume customers reported transient errors and retries; no data loss reported.

maria: 03:58 update: system stable for 6m, error rate <1.5%, no new restarts. Switching to monitoring mode. Will continue to watch for 30m.

jordan: Follow-ups/Action items assigned: 
- infra: investigate autoscaler thresholds and bump headroom (jordan)
- runtime: add retry/backoff improvements and KV-cache timeouts hardening (sri)
- alerts: tune 5xx alert sensitivity and add early encoder mem pressure metric (maria)

maria: Handoff in 20m to next on-call (liam). If anyone needs context for handoff, reply here.

liam: I'll take bridge at 04:18 UTC. Quick recap for handoff: issue was memory pressure triggering OOMs on model-worker; temporary mitigation was fallback routing + scale-up; infra requested GPU pool burst. No customer data lost.

maria: Handing off now — leaving notes: runbooks followed (runtime-oom), relevant logs: https://logs.example/r/INC-2026-0479, traces: https://traces.example/trace/abcd1234.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: primary -> liam at 1774457080.

liam: Acking handoff. Monitoring. Will escalate to SRE if error rate creeps above 3% again.

pagerduty: Incident still acknowledged. Time to resolution (TTR) not yet closed.

maria: Final note before stepping off: schedule postmortem in #postmortems, assign tentative owner @sri, draft due EOD.

liam: 04:25 update: stable for 27m, error rate steady ~0.6%, GPU pool scaled successfully, will keep watch for 3 more 10m windows then close.

pagerduty: Closing update pending — please file incident report and mark customer impact in PD.

maria: Thanks everyone. Good triage and quick scale. :thumbsup:

liam: Closing thread in 30m if stable.
